title: First-Period Rates for Emergency Dispatch Charges under the Calloway Limited Home Warranty
content:
**Clause.** The emergency dispatch charge under the Calloway Limited Home Warranty carries a first-period multiplier, applied to the program's emergency dispatch fee in the scheduled dispatch charge. The first-period multiplier reads the whole calendar months from the coverage start date to the assessment day together with the emergency dispatch charges ever assessed on the coverage: fewer than 12 months with no earlier dispatch charge takes 0.50; 12 to 23 months with no earlier dispatch charge takes 0.75; any other coverage takes 1.00, that is, no adjustment.

## Truth table

| Whole calendar months from the coverage start date to the assessment day | Any emergency dispatch charge ever assessed on the coverage | First-period multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| fewer than 12 | No | 0.50 |
| fewer than 12 | Yes | 1.00 |
| 12 to 23 | No | 0.75 |
| 12 to 23 | Yes | 1.00 |
| 24 or more | Either | 1.00 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical coverage start date 20 August 2024, no earlier dispatch charge)

- Assessed 19 August 2025: 11 whole months, 0.50.
- Assessed 20 August 2025: 12 whole months, 0.75.
- Assessed 20 August 2026: 24 whole months, 1.00.
